svg.title: Roamstead Google Cloud production architecture
svg.desc: Production architecture for Roamstead showing users, Google Cloud edge security, Cloud Run web and API services, Gemini, Gemini Embedding, two Gemma critics, Firestore vector memory, Cloud Storage, a weekly real listing pipeline, delivery, secrets, and operations.
